# Shan Shui source reference

Project: [{Shan, Shui}*](https://github.com/LingDong-/shan-shui-inf) by Lingdong Huang.

Reviewed commit: `9f754d2b2e73495db7883d4d4055a7b0903b0454`. The original [MIT license](LICENSE), including the 2018 copyright notice, is preserved verbatim.

Datascape's limited tree/rock prototypes are independent centerline implementations informed by reading the original procedural object rules. No upstream JavaScript is copied, translated, imported or executed. The original filled polygons, white cover polygons, mountain generator and page composition are not used. Geographic placement, fixed F2 projection, NDVI evidence and stroke hierarchy remain Datascape components.

Any future direct code adaptation must retain the applicable license and identify the source functions and changes. See the [source audit](../../docs/experiments/spring_color_ready_v02/shan_shui_audit.md).
